en.text:
I'm a {{Full Stack Developer}} and Software Engineering student at [[Ton Duc Thang University]], Ho Chi Minh City. I'm passionate about building scalable, production-ready systems — from event-driven microservices to cross-platform mobile apps.

I work primarily with {{NestJS}}, Next.js, and Flutter, and I have hands-on experience deploying systems on [[Google Cloud Platform]] using Docker, GitHub Actions CI/CD, and real-time communication with Socket.IO.

I enjoy solving complex end-to-end problems and I'm always eager to learn new technologies. I look forward to collaborating [[with you!]]

es.text:
Soy un {{desarrollador Full Stack}} y estudiante de Ingeniería de Software en [[Ton Duc Thang University]], Ciudad Ho Chi Minh. Me apasiona construir sistemas escalables y listos para producción, desde microservicios hasta apps móviles multiplataforma.

Trabajo principalmente con {{NestJS}}, Next.js y Flutter, con experiencia práctica desplegando en [[Google Cloud Platform]] con Docker y GitHub Actions.

Me encanta resolver problemas complejos de extremo a extremo. ¡Espero colaborar [[contigo!]]

fr.text:
Je suis un {{développeur Full Stack}} et étudiant en génie logiciel à [[Ton Duc Thang University]], Hô-Chi-Minh-Ville. Je suis passionné par la création de systèmes évolutifs et prêts pour la production, des microservices aux applications mobiles multiplateformes.

Je travaille principalement avec {{NestJS}}, Next.js et Flutter, avec une expérience de déploiement sur [[Google Cloud Platform]] avec Docker et GitHub Actions.

J'aime résoudre des problèmes complexes de bout en bout. Hâte de collaborer [[avec vous !]]

ko.text:
저는 호치민시 [[떤득탕 대학교]] 소프트웨어공학과 재학 중인 {{풀스택 개발자}}입니다. 이벤트 기반 마이크로서비스부터 크로스 플랫폼 모바일 앱까지 확장 가능한 프로덕션 시스템 구축에 열정을 갖고 있습니다.

주로 {{NestJS}}, Next.js, Flutter를 사용하며 Docker와 GitHub Actions CI/CD를 활용해 [[Google Cloud Platform]]에 시스템을 배포한 경험이 있습니다.

복잡한 문제를 처음부터 끝까지 해결하는 것을 즐깁니다. [[함께 협업]]하기를 기대합니다!
